# useR

Datasets and functions used to teach statistics with R.

## Installation

Você pode instalar a versão de desenvolvimento do pacote **useR** a
partir do GitHub da seguinte forma:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("fndemarqui/useR")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r
library(useR)
#> Loading required package: dplyr
#> 
#> Attaching package: 'dplyr'
#> The following objects are masked from 'package:stats':
#> 
#>     filter, lag
#> The following objects are masked from 'package:base':
#> 
#>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
#> Loading required package: ggplot2
#> Loading required package: shiny
data(nutricao)
cv(nutricao$peso)
#> [1] 17.77399
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`dgeom2()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/Geometric2.md)
  [`pgeom2()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/Geometric2.md)
  [`qgeom2()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/Geometric2.md)
  [`rgeom2()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/Geometric2.md)
  : The Geometric Distribution (Version 2)
- [`dnbinom2()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/NegBinomial2.md)
  [`pnbinom2()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/NegBinomial2.md)
  [`qnbinom2()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/NegBinomial2.md)
  [`rnbinom2()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/NegBinomial2.md)
  : The Negative Binomial Distribution (Version 2)
- [`carros`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/carros.md) :
  Testes de estrada de carros
- [`cdf()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/cdf.md) :
  Cumulative distribution function
- [`cv()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/cv.md) :
  Coefficient of Variation
- [`download_megasena()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/download_megasena.md)
  : Resultados da mega-sena
- [`enem`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/enem.md) : ENEM
  2019 em Belo Horizonte
- [`install_missing_packages()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/install_missing_packages.md)
  : Installation of missing packages
- [`is.installed()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/is.installed.md)
  : Checking if a package is installed
- [`nutricao`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/nutricao.md)
  : Hábito nutricional de um grupo de estudantes.
- [`resistencia`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/resistencia.md)
  : Resistência à compressão.
- [`run_app()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/run_app.md)
  : Function to run shiny apps
- [`start_clean_session()`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/start_clean_session.md)
  : Cleaning global environment and R search path
- [`useR-package`](https://fndemarqui.github.io/useR/reference/useR-package.md)
  : The 'useR' package.
